provenance: Controlled SDK-serialized application requests over mock transports. No provider calls, live acceptance, token measurements or cache measurements. Paired usage values are synthetic controls.

findings.title: No cache_control breakpoint set
findings.detail: Request 1 carries ≈8,095 Claude tokens but no cache_control marker, so nothing is ever cached even though this is part of a 4-request sequence. One line turns it on: a top-level "cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"} beside "model" puts a breakpoint on the last block of every request.
